editorial.blurb: A vibrant Thai noodle spot with rotating menu and night-market energy, where every dish is thoughtfully spiced and the chef's passion shines through.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead or check availability—the menu rotates frequently and they're only open 4 days a week. Order the phat kaphrao if you want fast service (2 minutes) or go large on noodle soups if you have a bigger appetite.

topDishes.note: Creamy, richly spiced curry broth with authentic preparation
Wonderful and customizable with noodle type choice
Fiery and quick, ready in 2 minutes when requested extra spicy
